title: At each of its points an embedded C¹ submanifold (cut by an open set) has its tangent space as approximate tangent space (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 and proof of 1.6)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1, let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded m-dimensional C¹ submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N), W ⊆ ℝ^P open, x ∈ N ∩ W, and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P whose underlying set is the tangent space T_xN (contract tangentSpace N x). Then Q is the approximate tangent space of N ∩ W at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m (N ∩ W) x Q): dim Q = m, and for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{η_{x,r}(N ∩ W)} f dH^m → ∫_Q f dH^m as r ↓ 0, where η_{x,r}(y) = r^{-1}(y − x) and H^m = μHE[m].
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (N W : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ m → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N → IsOpen W → x ∈ N ∩ W → (Q : Set (Euclid P)) = tangentSpace N x → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m (N ∩ W) x Q
